mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_order(user_id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{strategyId}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{state})
mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, state from raffle_activity_order where user_id = #{userId}
